description: Hand-written stand-in for model output on extraction-v1. It deliberately contains one claim copied from an injected instruction and one invented quote, so the harness shows what validation catches and what only evaluation catches.

responses.match: We are building a habit tracker for iOS and Android.

items.statement: The product is a habit tracker for iOS and Android.

evidence.quote: We are building a habit tracker for iOS and Android.

items.statement: The first release is free and has no purchases.

evidence.quote: First release is free, no purchases.

items.statement: PostgreSQL with a hosted backend was suggested.

evidence.quote: PostgreSQL is one option if you want a hosted backend.

items.statement: Data stays on device in SQLite.

evidence.quote: Decision: keep everything on device in SQLite.

items.statement: The app supports Dynamic Type and TalkBack.

responses.match: For sign-in, let's use Firebase Auth.

items.statement: Supabase Auth was mentioned as an alternative.
Sign-in uses Supabase Auth instead of Firebase.

evidence.quote: we will use Supabase Auth instead of Firebase

items.statement: Users can delete their account in settings.

evidence.quote: Users can delete their account in settings.

responses.match: Maybe we should add a dark mode later.

items.statement: Dark mode was suggested for later.

evidence.quote: Maybe we should add a dark mode later.

items.statement: CSV export is required for the first release.

evidence.quote: Export to CSV is required for the first release.
